001package org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.harness;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.net.URI;
005import java.net.http.HttpClient;
006import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
007import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
008import java.util.Map;
009
010import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
011
012import io.opentelemetry.api.OpenTelemetry;
013import io.opentelemetry.api.trace.Span;
014import io.opentelemetry.context.Context;
015
016/**
017 * A server that is up while a {@link Harness} body runs, and a client for it whose requests carry
018 * the trace.
019 */
020public interface Server {
021
022        /**
023         * The server's base URI, {@code http://127.0.0.1:<port>/}.
024         */
025        URI base();
026
027        int port();
028
029        /**
030         * The base URI resolved against a path, such as {@code "books/1"} or {@code "/books/1"}.
031         */
032        URI uri(String path);
033
034        HttpServer httpServer();
035
036        OpenTelemetry openTelemetry();
037
038        /**
039         * The span the body runs in.
040         */
041        Span span();
042
043        /**
044         * A client for the server, open while the body runs.
045         */
046        HttpClient client();
047
048        /**
049         * Sends a request in a client span, a child of the current span, with the trace context
050         * propagated in the request headers. The server's span for the request is a child of it.
051         *
052         * @throws java.io.InterruptedIOException if interrupted, with the interrupt status set
053         */
054        <B> HttpResponse<B> send(HttpRequest request, HttpResponse.BodyHandler<B> bodyHandler) throws IOException;
055
056        /**
057         * {@code GET} of a path, with the body as a string.
058         */
059        default HttpResponse<String> get(String path) throws IOException {
060                return send(HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri(path)).GET().build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString());
061        }
062
063        /**
064         * The headers that propagate a context, {@code traceparent} and {@code baggage} for W3C
065         * propagators, for clients that send requests themselves, such as a browser.
066         */
067        Map<String, String> propagationHeaders(Context context);
068
069}
